page_title: ATA 0-1 BOL | Atalanta v Bologna 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.

90+5' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) unleashes a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Lukasz Skorupski thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
90+3' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
89' The game is interrupted as Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is flagged offside.
88' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Jonathan Rowe and he is replaced by Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna).
88' Substitution. Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Davide Zappacosta walks off.
88' The linesman signals a throw-in for Bologna.
86' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
83' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) replaces Charles De Ketelaere.
81' Daniele Perenzoni blows for a foul after Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
79' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

78' 0 - 1 Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) meets a perfect cross from Jonathan Rowe deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the right post. The score is 0:1.
77' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) gets booked for the first time in this match.
76' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
75' Marco Carnesecchi displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
74' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
74' Bologna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
71' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' The ball is behind the touchline and Bologna will take a throw-in.
70' Juan Miranda (Bologna) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
69' Federico Bernardeschi goes off the pitch and Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) comes on.
69' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Tommaso Pobega is replaced by Nikola Moro (Bologna).
69' Here comes a substitution. Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) is brought on as a substitute for Santiago Castro.
67' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
65' A snap shot by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Lukasz Skorupski produces a good save to thwart him.
64' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) replaces Giacomo Raspadori.
63' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Nicola Zalewski will be replaced by Yunus Musah (Atalanta).
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marten de Roon as he is replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
62' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
60' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
59' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lukasz Skorupski comes off the line to clear the ball away.
58' Dangerous play by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta). Daniele Perenzoni blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Bologna are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.

55' Juan Miranda (Bologna) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
52' That's a clear yellow card. Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) goes into the book.
50' Half-chance! Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) plays a pass into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' The ball has crossed the sideline. Atalanta are taking a throw-in.

48' Joao Mario (Bologna) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniele Perenzoni blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a great save to deny Santiago Castro (Bologna) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' The ball is out of play. Bologna will take a throw-in.
44' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
41' Joao Mario (Bologna) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
40' A quickly taken corner by Bologna.

40' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Marco Carnesecchi pulls off an easy save.
37' A long ball forward to Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) is intercepted.
35' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Perenzoni blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) fails to keep his cool and squanders a golden chance to score from inside the penalty area after firing the ball over the crossbar.
33' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Marco Carnesecchi easily deals with the threat.

32' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
30' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
28' A player from Atalanta brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
26' Looks like Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
24' Atalanta work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
24' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
21' A cross from Juan Miranda (Bologna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
21' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Carnesecchi, who smothers the ball.
19' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) whips in a cross from the corner, but Marco Carnesecchi is well positioned and punches the ball away.
16' The linesman raises his flag. Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) is adjudged offside.
15' A spell of possession for Bologna in an attempt to control the game.
13' A player from Atalanta commits a rough challenge. Daniele Perenzoni blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
11' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
9' Atalanta are ruled offside.
8' A cross into the box from Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) is cleared.
8' Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
6' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
4' Neat passing move from Atalanta in order to create new attacking opportunities.
3' It's a throw-in for Bologna.
1' The match has just started.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Daniele Perenzoni will supervise the game today.
